description: This file implements the MainThread class and related factory functions for managing a dedicated main thread, including client registration, task queuing, and thread loop management within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: MainThread
classes.description: Manages a dedicated thread executing queued tasks, handles client registration/unregistration, and processes tasks in a loop.

classes.name: MainThread::TaskInfo
classes.description: Structure holding information about a queued task, including client ID, task function, synchronization primitives.

classes.name: MainThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving the singleton instance of MainThread.

classes.name: IMainThread
classes.description: Interface for MainThread, implemented by MainThread class.

classes.name: IMainThreadFactory
classes.description: Interface for the factory creating MainThread instances.

methods.name: MainThread::mainThreadLoop
methods.description: Main loop running in the dedicated thread, processing queued tasks and handling client registration status.

methods.name: MainThread::waitForTask
methods.description: Waits for and retrieves the next task from the task queue.

methods.name: MainThread::registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new client and returns its assigned client ID.

methods.name: MainThread::unregisterClient
methods.description: Unregisters a client by its ID.

methods.name: MainThread::enqueueTask
methods.description: Enqueues a task for execution by the main thread.

methods.name: MainThread::enqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Enqueues a task and waits for its completion.

methods.name: IMainThreadFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates an instance of the MainThread factory.

methods.name: MainThreadFactory::getMainThread
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MainThread, creating it if necessary.
